initial_spec.task: Classify CFTR in-frame deletion variant p.Phe508del under ACMG/AMP standards.
initial_assumptions: In-frame deletion in critical CFTR NBD1 domain
constraints: Ensure no double counting of functional assays

evidence_schedule.content: CFTR VCEP guideline mandates PM4 (protein length change) can only be scored if functional assay PS3 is not applied at strong strength.
Cohort analysis confirms two separate publications analyzed the exact same patient registry (CF Registry 2018). Merge case counts to avoid double-counting PS4.
Control frequency update: gnomAD shows allele frequency 0.008 (0.8%), which invalidates PM2 (extreme rarity threshold <0.0001). However, high homozygous patient counts confirm pathogenicity.
Clinical context updated from carrier screening to confirmed diagnostic pediatric patient with sweat chloride > 60 mmol/L.

ground_truth.provenance: Well-established canonical pathogenic variant (ClinVar 3-star expert review).
